svg.aria-label: How a notice becomes a deadline, in seven steps. 1 Upload: drop a PDF or take a photo. 2 Read: the text layer first, then OCR with PaddleOCR and Tesseract, each only if needed. 3 Translate: Indian languages, offline, with IndicTrans2 on your server; the original stays the proof. 4 Find: rules read every notice for duties, amounts and hearings, and return a date rule, never a date. Optional AI (off, local, your own key or the Dueproof plan, routed Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) helps only where rules aren't sure, and its findings pass the same proof gate. 5 Compute: the date engine counts, with holidays and its working shown. 6 Prove: each finding is outlined on its page; an unlocated finding waits for a person. 7 Track: case, deadline, reminders, calendar and iCal feed. A person decides.

g.text: RULES FIRST / AI OPTIONAL / EVERY DATE COMPUTED
Drop a PDF or take a photo.
A DATE RULE, NEVER A DATE
Off, local, your key, our plan.
rules and AI findings reconciled; each date rule becomes a date
